description: Adaptive Learning Engine - IRT-based question selection that dynamically adjusts difficulty based on per-topic performance. Builds on existing difficulty-progression.ts and weak-topic-engine.ts to implement a Bayesian ability estimator that tracks theta (ability) per topic, selects questions at the optimal difficulty frontier, and provides 'next best question' recommendations.
steps: Create src/features/adaptive-learning/ directory with types/, utils/, components/, and __tests__/ subdirectories

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/types/index.ts with interfaces: AbilityEstimate (theta, standardError, topicBreakdown), AdaptiveState (current ability, history, questionsSeen), AdaptiveRecommendation (questionId, reason, expectedInformationGain)

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/utils/ability-estimator.ts implementing a simplified IRT model: (1) updateAbility(currentTheta, questionDifficulty, correct) using ELO-style Bayesian update, (2) estimateAbility(attempts) to compute theta from history, (3) computeInformationGain(theta, questionDifficulty) to measure expected learning value of a question

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/utils/adaptive-selector.ts that takes the question pool and AdaptiveState, selects the question with maximum information gain at the student's ability frontier, considering topic coverage and avoiding recently-seen questions

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/utils/adaptive-storage.ts to persist AdaptiveState to localStorage under key 'cfa-buddy-adaptive-state', following the pattern in src/features/question-bank/utils/attempt-storage.ts

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/utils/topic-mastery.ts that computes per-topic ability levels by aggregating attempts per topic, exposing getTopicMasteryMap() returning Record<string, {theta: number, questionsAnswered: number, accuracy: number}>

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/components/adaptive-session.tsx - a client component that runs an adaptive practice session: fetches next-best question, renders it, records answer, updates ability estimate in real-time. Follow UI patterns from existing practice components.
Create src/features/adaptive-learning/components/mastery-overview.tsx - a visual display showing per-topic ability levels as a radar chart or colored grid, using the Navy/Gold/Green theme colors
Add 'Adaptive' as a new TestMode in src/features/question-bank/types/index.ts (add to the union type)

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/__tests__/ability-estimator.test.ts with tests: (1) correct answers increase theta, (2) wrong answers decrease theta, (3) harder questions give more theta gain, (4) information gain is maximized when question difficulty matches theta, (5) convergence after many attempts

Create src/features/adaptive-learning/__tests__/adaptive-selector.test.ts testing: (1) selects questions near ability level, (2) avoids recently seen questions, (3) balances topic coverage, (4) handles empty question pool gracefully
Add route page at src/app/(protected)/practice/adaptive/page.tsx that renders the adaptive session component
Update src/shared/config/navigation.ts to add an 'Adaptive' link under the Questions section with Brain icon, href '/practice/adaptive'
acceptance_criteria: Running npm run test passes all new tests in src/features/adaptive-learning/__tests__/
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
The adaptive engine correctly selects harder questions after correct answers and easier questions after wrong answers
Per-topic mastery is tracked and persisted in localStorage
The adaptive session page renders without errors
